canceled_void_policy: canceled and void outcomes are excluded and counted separately; they never receive a score
conflict_policy: a self-contradicting outcome row is excluded, counted and preserved; it is never repaired to make a member scorable

declared_baselines.base_rate_brier: Brier of a constant forecast equal to the observed prevalence within this experiment's own matured members

end_condition: sample floor reached AND minimum_matured_fraction satisfied
evaluation_horizons: market close time plus a 3600s settlement grace

feature_definitions.domain: research packet domain at forecast time

hypothesis: Brier skill versus the base-rate benchmark remains strictly positive for baseball forecasts created after start_time.
invalidating_conditions: evaluation code digests drift without disclosure
known_limitations: baseball is 85 percent of the scored population, so this result and the aggregate will move together and are not independent evidence
prevalence is non-stationary, so the benchmark itself moves
market_population: Kalshi baseball markets discovered by the standard scan, forecast by the baseball_evidence family at version v1
missing_data_policy: members whose markets have not matured are counted as pending and excluded from the metric; never imputed
multiple_testing_policy: one primary metric; ECE is descriptive only and cannot be promoted
null_hypothesis: Brier skill versus the base-rate benchmark is at most zero.

rationale: Baseball forecasts produced by baseball_evidence v1 on or after registration, with a research packet present.

Membership is decided ONLY by these typed forecast-time predicates. Pending outcomes remain pending; unscorable rows are reported; sample-floor and matured-fraction rules decide evaluability, never membership.

window_end is declared 'unbounded' deliberately: the end condition is the sample floor plus matured fraction, not a calendar date. Declaring it explicitly is what stops an evaluator choosing the end after seeing results.

provider_policy: no new provider and no paid provider; the existing read-only Kalshi market-detail path only, at the cadence MarketOps already runs
research_question: Does the baseball calibration and base-rate skill measured on the post-drain population persist on forecasts created after registration?
safety_boundary: measurement only; no expected value, recommendation, sizing, order, wallet or capital behavior is produced or implied, and calibration is not an edge claim

signal_definitions.none: no signal gating; every eligible forecast enters

stale_score_policy: only scored_current members enter; stale rows are excluded
start_condition: the first forecast whose created_at is at or after start_time; no forecast existing at registration is eligible
stopping_rule: a single evaluation once the sample floor and matured fraction are both satisfied; no interim looks, and the experiment is not stopped early on a favourable reading
title: Baseball prospective calibration stability
